_comment: Icons offered when someone creates or edits their own playlist. Served no-cache, so adding one here is live on the next page load — no deploy stamp to bust. Each `file` must exist as a master at artwork/<file> in the S3 bucket; the pickers render the artwork/resized/<name>_300.webp derivative and fall back to the master if the resizer hasn't run yet. Icons whose image fails to load are dropped from the grid.
